metadata.description: Marketplace for the OPM engineering workflow plugin for Claude Code and its optional explainer-video and design add-ons

plugins.name: opm
plugins.description: An opinionated engineering workflow: brainstorm, plan, TDD execution with fresh-context subagents, verification, captured learnings. Lean reviewers, stack patterns and six light safety hooks.

plugins.name: opm-video
plugins.description: Optional add-on: turns a spec or document into a narrated explainer video. Needs a headless browser, ffmpeg and a text-to-speech voice; the neural voice (edge-tts) sends narration text to a Microsoft cloud service unless the local OS voice is used.

plugins.name: opm-design
plugins.description: Optional add-on: design direction and a quality floor before UI code, a validated DESIGN.md, user-flow maps, and visual QA with screenshots and an independent reviewer. Uses the project's Playwright when present; otherwise it asks before downloading Playwright, axe-core and Chromium (about 150 MB) into ~/.opm/design-tools.
